subject.title: fix(ui): prevent Nostr profile publish/import hangs

question: Should Nostr profile publish/import enforce an unconditional 30-second Control UI deadline, or must the deadline derive from the backend operation contract?
rationale: The patch correctly bounds a hang, but repository evidence does not establish whether legitimate relay work can exceed 30 seconds or whether aborting the browser request cancels the mutation, so accepting that compatibility behavior requires owner intent.

options.title: Derive the deadline from backend limits
options.body: Document the backend's maximum operation time, set the UI deadline above that bound, and add a slow-progress regression case before merge.

options.title: Accept the fixed 30-second boundary
options.body: Explicitly accept that operations exceeding 30 seconds may surface a client timeout even if server-side work continues, and document or test the resulting recovery behavior.

options.title: Pause pending cancellable operations
options.body: Defer this PR until the backend can cancel or expose mutation status so the UI never reports an ambiguous timeout outcome.

recommendation.title: Derive the deadline from backend limits
recommendation.body: Document the backend's maximum operation time, set the UI deadline above that bound, and add a slow-progress regression case before merge.

likelyOwner.reason: The contributor explicitly requested this owner's decision on the timeout policy, and the question affects product compatibility rather than a mechanical patch detail.
